package control

func flow(ch chan int, x interface{}) int {
	total := 0
	for i, v := range []int{1, 2, 3} {
		total += i + v
	}
	for key := range map[string]int{"a": 1} {
		_ = key
	}
	switch t := x.(type) {
	case int:
		total += t
	case string:
		total += len(t)
	}
	select {
	case got := <-ch:
		total += got
	default:
	}
outer:
	for {
		for {
			break outer
		}
	}
	return total
}
